richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the 3rd row seat belt stalk mounting bolt may not have been tightened to the correct specification during body modification. There is the possibility the seat belt mounting bolt could vibrate loose and in the worst case scenario become detached so not restraining the occupant in the seat should the vehicle be involved in a frontal collision..
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicle and retorque the mounting bolt  to the correct specification.
